titel: Days out around Venray: animals and attractions | Hotel Asteria
omschrijving: Days out from Hotel Asteria in Venray: ZooParc Overloon, Mind Mystery, Toverland and the thermal baths in Arcen, with drive times from the hotel.
hero-sub: Watch the animals, solve puzzles in an escape room or spend a day at the thermal baths, then head back to your own room.
hero-alt: Two lions lying close together at ZooParc Overloon
intro-tekst: ZooParc Overloon is eleven minutes' drive away and Mind Mystery in Horst ten. Toverland and the thermal baths in Arcen are about half an hour by car. Close enough for a relaxed breakfast in the morning and to be back in time for the wellness area in the evening.

m1-tekst: After breakfast you're at ZooParc Overloon in eleven minutes. Arrive early: that's when the animals are most active.
m1-alt: A couple having breakfast in bathrobes
m2-tekst: Walk through the themed areas and take your time with your favourite animals.
m2-alt: A ring-tailed lemur at ZooParc Overloon
m3-tekst: Back at the hotel, the saunas, steam room and plunge pool on the Top Floor await.

m4-tekst: Round off with dinner made with regional produce, then off to your room.

f1-v: Which day out is closest to the hotel?
f1-a: Mind Mystery in Horst is ten minutes' drive away, ZooParc Overloon eleven.
f2-a: Toverland in Sevenum is about half an hour's drive from the hotel.
f3-v: Can I still use the wellness area after a day at the thermal baths?
f3-a: Yes. Back at the hotel, the wellness area on the Top Floor awaits, with four saunas, a steam room and a plunge pool. Ask reception about opening times.
f4-v: Is ZooParc Overloon open all year?
f4-a: Opening times vary by season. Check the park's website before you go.
f5-v: Can I check in late after a day out?
f5-a: Let reception know if you'll be arriving later and we'll plan for it. Just call +31 478 511 466.
f6-v: How do I book a room for my day out?
f6-a: Choose a room above or use the booking button. You'll see straight away which dates are free.
